title: Surreal Mechanical Mask
description: A large, cracked porcelain-like theatrical mask dominates the scene, its surface embedded with film reels, clapperboards, robotic machinery, and glowing purple circuitry. The eyes contain miniature scenes of winged figures within orbs while a larger glowing bubble to the right shows a radiant winged silhouette against a dystopian cityscape with robotic figures below.
prompt: Surreal cinematic scene featuring a giant cracked porcelain theater mask floating in a cloudy sky. The mask is adorned with film reels, clapperboards, and intricate mechanical robotic elements in teal and purple. Its eyes contain glowing orbs showing tiny winged human figures. A large transparent bubble on the right contains a radiant purple winged silhouette emitting green energy. Below are dystopian ruined buildings, robots, floating film strips and framed pictures against a moody, cloudy sky.
